seo.title: SEO Packages & Pricing
seo.description: SEO packages for small businesses with published monthly prices in pounds: technical SEO, keyword research, content and link building. No long-term contract.

header.title: SEO & content plans
header.lede: Ongoing content, technical SEO and link building — delivered on a predictable monthly retainer. For AI, automation or custom software work, get in touch for a scoped quote.

emptyState.beforeEmail: Our plan details can’t be shown right now. Please try again shortly, or email
emptyState.afterEmail: and we’ll send you current pricing.

custom.title: Custom Solutions
custom.subtitle: Scoped to your brief
custom.body: Need more than a retainer covers? Tell us what you’re working towards and we’ll put together a personalised package, with scope tailored across SEO, AI, automation and software.

billing.title: Billing and terms.
billing.intro: The short version of our terms for SEO plans.

items.title: Billed monthly
items.body: Plans are billed monthly in advance through Stripe, our payment processor, and renew each month until cancelled.

items.title: Prices exclude tax
items.body: Prices are shown exclusive of any applicable tax, which is added at checkout where relevant.

items.title: No long-term contract
items.body: You can cancel at any time. We ask for 30 days’ notice, so active work can be wound down in an orderly way.

items.title: No ranking guarantees
items.body: Rankings, traffic and revenue depend on factors outside anyone’s control, so we commit to the work in your plan, not to a position in search results.

otherServices.title: Other services.
otherServices.intro: AI integration, workflow automation and custom software are quoted per project rather than sold as plans. Each starts with a conversation about the work, and scope and cost are agreed before it begins.
